description: Isotropic linear elasticity  sigma = lambda*tr(eps)*I + 2*mu*eps  (lambda=1.3, mu=0.7). Gold is CalculiX's own built-in *ELASTIC (E=1.855, nu=0.325). Each test compares the generated material (run via its input deck) against the gold; abs_tol/rel_tol default to the harness values unless set here (manifest-level) or per case.
